description: Searches the published precedent library (letters, agreements, clauses, checklists, forms, policies and more for every practice area) by title, summary and when to use it. Returns ids, titles, kinds, practice area ids, jurisdictions and the date each states the law as at. The full text is available through the signed-in firm connector.

area.description: Optional practice area id, for example "A1".

query.description: Words to search for, 2 to 200 characters.

name: search_precedents
title: Search the precedent library
